prompt_instructions: Attach the original image for exact typography spacing, scale, and banner geometry.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown, including Vietnamese diacritics.
Do not add products or people; this creative must stay as a text-first sale poster.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square BADASS sale poster with a soft sky-blue to pale mint gradient background. Put the white word 'BADASS' at the top center. Add a yellow taped banner with black text 'POLO MỚI' and a blue offset shadow behind it. Below that place the word 'SALE' in medium blue. Make the centerpiece a giant royal-blue '60%' with a small cream tag attached by a yellow string reading 'UP TO' near the top-right of the zero. At the bottom center place 'END SEASON 2026' in black followed by smaller black text 'TOÀN BỘ HỆ THỐNG TỪ 17/07'. Along the bottom edge, add a repeating yellow-and-white strip reading 'SALE BADASS SALE BADASS SALE'. Technical style: graphic design sale poster with smooth gradient background and bold vector typography, flat graphic lighting, bright retail energy, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, photoreal objects, people, incorrect Vietnamese text, blurry edges, weak contrast, low resolution, clutter, warped numbers, watermark, signature
